triggers.name: event_end
triggers.title: Event end
triggers.help: Triggers when an event ends in Google Calendar. When recipe is first started, trigger will fetch events that ended in the past hour. Subsequently, new events are fetched as soon as they end.

input.name: id
input.label: Calendar
input.hint: Select a calendar to monitor for event end.

input.name: query
input.label: Search term
input.hint: Triggers only events matching search term in the following fields: summary , location , description , attendee's and organizer's display name and/or email .

triggers.name: event_start
triggers.title: Event start
triggers.help: Triggers at or a specified time before an event starts in Google Calendar. When recipe is first started, trigger will fetch events that started in the past hour and events starting after the specified time (if any). Subsequently, new events are fetched as soon as they hit the start time criteria.

input.name: id
input.label: Calendar
input.hint: Select a calendar to monitor for event start.

input.name: time_unit
input.label: Time before unit
input.hint: Select a time unit for Time before event start .

input.name: trigger_before
input.label: Time before event start
input.hint: Enter the time before the event start you want the trigger to pick up the event. The minimum allowed duration is 5 minutes.

input.name: query
input.label: Search term
input.hint: Triggers only events matching search term in the following fields: summary , location , description , attendee's and organizer's display name and/or email .

triggers.name: new_event
triggers.title: New event
triggers.help: Triggers when new event is created in a specific calendar. When recipe is first started, trigger will fetch events created since an hour ago.Subsequently, new events are fetched as soon as they occur.

input.name: id
input.label: Calendar
input.hint: Select a calendar to monitor for events

input.name: include_deleted
input.label: Include deleted events?
input.hint: When set to true , job will be triggered for deleted events also. Defaults to false

triggers.name: updated_event
triggers.title: New/updated event
triggers.help: Triggers when event is created or updated in a specific calendar. When recipe is first started, trigger will fetch events created or updated since an hour ago.Subsequently, new or updated events are fetched as soon as they occur.

input.name: id
input.label: Calendar
input.hint: Select a calendar to monitor for events

input.name: include_deleted
input.label: Include deleted events?
input.hint: When set to true , job will be triggered for deleted events also. Defaults to false

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Google Calendar action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized under your Google Calendar connection OAuth scopes: Scopes calendar:read, calendar:write, tasks:read, tasks:write, userinfo.email:read

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: add_attendee_to_an_event
actions.title: Add attendees to an event
actions.description: Add list of attendees to an event in Google Calendar
actions.help: Appends a list of attendees to an existing event.Existing event attendees will not be affected. If a duplicate email address is passed in,it overwrites the existing attendee's response and comments.

input.name: id
input.label: Calendar
input.hint: Select calendar that event belongs to

input.name: event_id
input.label: Event ID
input.hint: Obtain event ID from the Search events action. You can also obtain the event ID from your event URL.

properties.name: email
properties.label: Attendee email
properties.hint: Email address of attendee to invite

properties.name: optional
properties.label: Optional
properties.hint: Whether this is an optional attendee

properties.name: responseStatus
properties.label: Response status
properties.hint: Attendee's attendance response. Valid values are needsAction , declined , tentative , accepted

input.name: sendNotifications
input.label: Send notifications?
input.hint: If true , will notify all attendees about changed event

actions.name: create_allday_event
actions.title: Create all day event
actions.description: Create all day event in Google Calendar
actions.help: Creates an all day event in Google Calendar. You can create events in calendars belonging to other Google users if you have the permissions to change events.

input.name: id
input.label: Calendar
input.hint: Select the calendar to create event in

input.name: start
input.label: Start date
input.hint: Enter event start date

input.name: end
input.label: End date
input.hint: Event end date and time

input.name: end_time_new
input.label: End date time
input.hint: Provide event end date for all day event

input.name: time_zone
input.label: Displayed time zone
input.hint: Does not change time input, only displays the date time in the selected time zone.

input.name: summary
input.label: Name
input.hint: Event name or summary

input.name: attendees
input.label: Attendee emails
input.hint: Comma-separated list of attendees to invite

input.name: sendNotifications
input.label: Send notifications?
input.hint: This field is deprecated. This field will be overridden by send updates field. If true , sends notifications about created or updated events.

input.name: sendUpdates
input.label: Send updates
input.hint: Provide all to send notification to all guests, externalOnly to send notifcations to non-Google Calendar guests, none to not send any notifcations.

input.name: guestsCanModify
input.label: Guests can modify?
input.hint: Guests can modify event

input.name: guestsCanSeeOtherGuests
input.label: Display guests list?
input.hint: Setting this to No will hide the guests list. Defaults to Yes .

input.name: status
input.label: Status
input.hint: Valid values are confirmed , cancelled , tentative . Defaults to confirmed if left blank.

input.name: visibility
input.label: Visibility
input.hint: Possible values are default , public , private . Defaults to configured visibility of calendar.

input.name: transparency
input.label: Show me as
input.hint: Determines whether the event time is blocked in your calendar. Possible values are Available , Busy . Defaults to Busy if left blank.

input.name: time_zone
input.label: Time zone
input.hint: Must be one of the standard time zones , e.g. US/Eastern
